design: controlled calibration: real answers that a reviewer labelled correct (v4.6u or16 review-evidence excerpts + or10 sample) and controlled copies of the same answers: value 25% off gold, value 3x the tolerance band off gold, unit scale x1000, refusal answered with a number (all incorrect), and value moved half the tolerance band (still correct)
caveat: Not a hand-labelled sample of judge-vs-grader disagreements: the or16 trial directories were deleted, and every recoverable labelled answer was correct. This shows Haiku separates correct from controlled wrong answers as well as Nemotron did; it does not measure borderline cases (partial answers, wording, sign convention). Re-check with hand labels on pilot disagreements before seal.
